decisions.why: every product is a reacher/grabber (Handi-Grip, Classic PRO etc.) -- a classic daily-living aid, matching this framework's own title (Walking Aids and Simple Aids for Daily Living)
every product is an explicit shower stool/chair -- a bathing aid
every product is a long-handled wash sponge/brush -- a personal hygiene aid
every product is an explicit bath/shower board -- a bathing aid

every product in this division is actually a pair of elbow/forearm crutches (e.g. 'Adjustable Elbow Crutch', 'Double Adjustable Forearm Crutches') -- a walking aid by name, the division label names the clinical context rather than the product type
a commode chair and a toilet frame -- toileting aids, in the same hub type as bathing aids
every product is an explicit walking stick
Meywalk4 is a named walking frame/walker
a shoe horn / shoe helper is a classic daily-living dressing aid
'The Leg-Up Leg Lifter' is an explicit dressing aid
a stocking-application aid is a daily-living/dressing aid
a sock aid is a classic daily-living dressing aid
both products are named rollators (wheeled walking frames with seat) -- walking aids, the division label names the clinical purpose rather than the product type
SymmetriSeat 50/70 are specialist postural seating products -- wheelchairs/specialist seating is explicitly in this framework's in-scope categories
